policy.description: Blocking line-coverage ratchets. For a fixed scope, coveredLines is the highest value in the reviewed clean-run observation envelope, never a modal or repeated lower value, and that high-water never decreases. Update the envelope in the same reviewed change whenever scope or coverage advances. A fixed-scope floor may move downward only to the exact minimum directly observed by clean runs on the identical source, tests, and total-line scope, with linked evidence and a bounded tolerance; unexplained coverage loss remains a regression.

tolerance.rationale: Issue #717 adds a lazy identity- and navigation-fenced awards details module and its focused tests outside the fixed Jellyfin.Plugin.JellyfinCanopy/src/core/** instrumentation scope, rebased on the combined #718/#732/#733 main tree. Two clean full client runs on this exact 273-file and 2,629-test tree passed every test and both measured 2,976/3,362 core lines (88.519%) without instrumentation spread. The reviewed observed high-water and exact observed floor therefore remain 2,976/3,362 with zero tolerance; the prior #718 evidence established this core source scope, while these runs establish the same exact ratchet against the expanded issue #717 tree. coverage-baseline.test.js retains the exact below-floor, above-baseline, scope-change, observed-high-water, and broad-tolerance negative boundaries.

Issue #717 adds the disabled-by-default atomic Wikidata awards index, bounded serialized keyset pagination and resumable checkpoints, authorized minimal controller, scheduled/manual execution ownership, and identity- and navigation-fenced details UI on top of the combined #718/#732/#733 main tree. Its R5 lifecycle remediation gives every shared refresh generation an explicit final-waiter, live-disable, host-stop, and disposal cancellation-and-join owner; replacement admission and live re-enable now wait outside the owner lock until every retired physical generation settles, so the singleton checkpoint path cannot overlap a stale post-cancellation Save or Delete. Four deterministic same-path cases cross final-waiter and disable-to-reenable retirement with stale Save and Delete commit windows while preserving surviving-waiter semantics. Two clean local .NET SDK 10.0.109/runtime 10.0.9 full-suite coverage runs on this exact 57,038-line source and 4,475-test scope passed every test and measured 47,105/57,038 (82.585294%) and 47,109/57,038 (82.592307%). The reviewed observed high-water is therefore 47,109/57,038 and the exact observed floor is 47,105/57,038; the four-line instrumentation spread is 0.007013 percentage points, within the 0.15-point policy maximum. Earlier R4 observations belong to prior source and test scopes and are not mixed into this final envelope; both accepted R5 runs completed the identical canonical test scope and only the intentionally stale scope ratchet failed afterward. coverage-baseline.test.js retains the exact scope-drift, regression, stale-baseline, observed-high-water, spread, single-run, and broad-tolerance negative boundaries.
